$comment: Owners of this repository. Format: a JSON object whose 'owners' array holds one entry per owner with 'id' (lowercase, referenced by penguin/scopes.json and penguin/identities.json), 'display_name', 'delegate_owner_id' (the id of the owner who reviews in this owner's absence, or null) and 'role' (one of 'owner', 'delegate', 'integrator', 'observer').
